# NeuronalNetworkSelfOrganization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which living neuronal networks spontaneously develop structured connectivity and dynamics that satisfy both high phi and low free energy without external supervision. Offers a biological blueprint for self-organizing in-network neuromorphic systems, enabling adaptive and resilient computation in distributed TCC fabrics.
